entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child with neck-length brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls, riding Vehicle A.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low tricycle ridden by Person A, with a tall blue backrest, a low red frame, wide black rear wheels, and curved metal handlebars.

entities.name: lobby floor
entities.identification: The flat, dark brown, glossy, wood-like floor in the lobby.

entities.name: orange-and-white striped lobby carpet
entities.identification: The lobby carpet with wide longitudinal orange and off-white stripes and light-colored stepped patterns.

entities.name: staircase
entities.identification: The switchback staircase within the wall opening, with light-colored flights, brown stair areas, and slender black railings.

entities.name: interior wall
entities.identification: The light beige lobby wall with wall columns, recessed wall sections, a staircase opening, and dark baseboards.

entities.name: lobby seat
entities.identification: The light-colored striped armchairs on both sides of the staircase, as well as the brown upholstered chair partially visible at the right edge at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: potted green plant
entities.identification: The set of potted plants with upright clusters of green leaves on the staircase landing and at the edge of the lobby.

entities.name: lobby wall lamp
entities.identification: The wall-mounted light fixture with a dark decorative base, slender lamp arms, and two candle-like illuminated lamp heads.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The larger rectangular framed picture with a light-colored image area to the right of the staircase, as well as several small framed pictures above the staircase.

entities.name: lobby red wall plate
entities.identification: The set of red disc-shaped ornaments on the wall on the right side of the lobby.

entities.name: lobby branch flower arrangement
entities.identification: The flower arrangement to the left of the staircase opening, composed of thin, branching brown twigs spreading upward and outward.
